newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB sets $150 million, three-yr FRCD.
newsitem.headline: PNB sets $150 million, three-yr FRCD.

text.p: Philippine National Bank will launch a $150-million floating rate certificate of deposit (FRCD) on Monday, lead manager HSBC Markets said.
HSBC Markets is Hongkong Bank's treasury and capital markets arm.
The issue will have a maturity of three years with no puts or calls and will offer a coupon of three-month U.S. dollar LIBOR plus 0.65 percent, HSBC said.
The FRCD will be issued from PNB's Hong Kong office.
PNB's long-term foreign curreny debt obligations are rated Ba2 by Moody's Investor Service, the same rating as the Philippine government. Moody's rated PNB's bank deposits Ba3, the statement said.
